submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final independent traditional Chinese festival event banner for the Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: target native 2098 × 749 pixels, very wide landscape 2.8:1, opaque edge-to-edge illustration. Never a whole interface or a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY approved style, chibi-character and horizontal-composition reference. Input image 2 is the approved mail interface context; use its painting quality only, never copy UI frames, borders, controls or writing.
Preserve the reference's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: precise polished contours, full rounded shapes, rich but restrained painterly detail, convincing cloth/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal landscape, ivory cloth, warm gold accents, clean air and soft depth. Luminous but properly exposed highlights. Premium 2D illustration, not flat vector or plastic 3D.
Character on the RIGHT THIRD: one small chibi Taoist boy, the same large brown eyes, rosy round face, short spiky brown hair, golden headband with knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd on belt. Big head and short limbs. Keep his face, hands and all important props within safe edges.
LEFT 45% stays comparatively quiet: softly layered distant scenery and mist or sky, suitable for future overlaid text, but do not paint any text. Foreground thematic props concentrate on the right. Do not place the character on the left.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no Chinese or English characters, pseudo-writing, numerals, calligraphy, watermark, logo, UI border, graphic frame. Plain lanterns and plain packets must have NO characters. No giant moon, mooncakes, rabbit or Mid-Autumn osmanthus. Change the scene to the festival below instead of copying the reference night setting.
Rendering goal: highest available refined finished painting; the host manages the model and quality.
Festival-specific scene: Theme: Zhongyuan festival (中元), compassionate and peaceful remembrance with lotus river lanterns. Soft blue-hour summer twilight, quiet teal mountains and water on the left, no giant moon. On the right the boy kneels safely on a rounded stone riverbank and gently releases a single small warmly glowing lotus-shaped river lantern; a small number of lanterns float downstream, soft reflections and green lotus leaves. His expression is tender and serene. One small bowl of fruit on the bank, restrained golden glow. Warm blessing and remembrance, absolutely no ghosts, skeletons, tombstones, spooky figures, funeral paper or horror.

Anatomy and contact refinement: both hands are anatomically coherent, with five natural fingers per hand, fingers may overlap naturally but never merge into extra fingers. One hand gently releases the rim of the lotus lantern at the waterline, while the other supports him on the stone bank. Both feet remain safely on the stone and are coherent with a comfortable kneeling pose, no duplicate limbs. His expression is a soft closed-mouth smile. Give all important body parts and the lantern comfortable margins. Preserve the approved polished rich painting detail without noisy texture. The left 45% is quiet blue-teal water and softly layered distant hills; only a few tiny warm river lanterns lead downstream toward the distant center. The local lantern glow is warm but subtle; retain ivory fabric shading, skin midtones, petal details and a clear readable face. Summer-to-early-autumn blue-hour foliage and lotus leaves, not winter or spring. Generate exactly one uninterrupted very wide 2.8:1 banner, target 2098 by 749 pixels.

visualReview.method: 直接查看实际生成图（原始2098×749）并与两张已打开的参考图比较；另由独立子代理复查。未使用全库或客户端验收代替像素检查。
visualReview.theme: 蓝调暮色、莲花河灯、临水寄思与一碗果供可辨；无巨月、月饼、玉兔、桂花、鬼怪或恐怖物件。
visualReview.style: 与两张参考图同款圆脸大眼、金发带、短棕发、玉绿金边米白衣装与太极葫芦；圆润饱满、精细手绘体积及清透暮色。
visualReview.face: 面部清楚、眼睛协调、温柔微笑，无明显畸变或过曝。
visualReview.hands: 放灯手与花瓣边缘接触合理，撑地手落在石阶上。未见明显多指、断指或穿模；局部手指被花瓣或自身遮挡，不能逐根确认两手全部五指。
visualReview.feet: 跪姿与膝部关系自然，后侧一只鞋可见；另一只脚被衣摆与身体遮挡，未见明显增肢，未声称双脚完全可见。
visualReview.propContact: 河灯底座接水并有涟漪、倒影；手指靠近灯缘；果碗落在石台上，葫芦由腰侧绳带承接。
visualReview.composition: 人物及关键放灯动作集中右侧，重要部分未裁断。左45%为较低视觉重量的山水与水面，适合短标题；保留部分建筑、倒影及边角荷叶，不属于纯色空白，也不建议直接叠多行正文。
visualReview.text: 未见可读文字、伪文字、水印、商标、界面边框或拼图。
visualReview.exposure: 皮肤与米白衣服保留阴影和层次；暖金河灯局部有明亮光芯，画面未全局泛白。
limitations: 遮挡处无法逐根数清全部手指或同时看见两只脚。
这次仅为独立图片验收，不代表网页整批或Unity接入验收。
